issue.title: agents_neighbors PNG snapshots fail fix-tui-screenshots determinism verify under load
issue.description: Agents-tab neighbors PNG scenes pass the first capture but disagree on determinism verify under host load.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-14y.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes #2/#3, 2026-09-21T12:07Z) and routed by the sase-14y land agent.
During `just fix-tui-screenshots` runs for the launch-context cluster, the agents_neighbors scenes
(`above_sase_context`, plus a `modal_dismissed_descendant` scene that no longer exists on master)
passed their first capture but failed determinism verification (`verify_hash_mismatch`); the same
failure reproduced on a pristine tree, so it is not caused by sase-14y. Fail rate not measured;
observed under a loaded host with other agents running. Related to, but distinct from, sase-14w
(different tests and symptom, same verify mechanism) and sase-14b (live neighbor state in
agents_fleet). Note: the sase-14q top-bar proc-chip fix landed 2026-09-21T14:07Z, after this
observation — first check whether the flake persists on current master.
